title: Home practical guide and safety card: rubber band stretch
subject: Science
source: Written for science/y7 lesson 43 (Home practical guide and safety card: rubber band stretch (portal worksheet; face back, loads over a cushion))
intro: Lesson 43: Home investigation: stretching a rubber band. A practical to do at home with an adult nearby. Read it all first.

practical.aim: To find out how a rubber band stretches with load
equipment: Equal loads (for example 50 g packets or coins)
safety: Face back, loads over a cushion
An adult knows what you are doing and is nearby
Clear a space and tidy up afterwards; wash your hands
method: Hang the band from a hook; put the bag on it over a cushion
Measure the length with no load
Add one load and measure again; keep your face back
Work out the extension each time (new length minus original)

questions.a: A result that does not fit
options: A result that does not fit

questions.q: Big question: does a wobbly line mean failure?
questions.a: No: look at the trend, find anomalies and repeat.
